card.name: Takalo
card.profile: The takalo is a Niuean war dance. Performed by an individual warrior or group of warriors, the dance is a formal challenge, and was traditionally performed prior to engaging the enemy with traditional war clubs. In modern times, the takalo is often performed prior to a rugby game or winning a game of some sport code. The takalo is also performed to welcome dignitaries upon arrival into Niue, and signifies that the dignitaries' arrival is for the purpose of peace and harmony.
card.insight: The takalo is a Niuean war dance.

observation.setting: Outdoor grassy field near trees and water, overcast day, with documentary-style cutaways to an indoor community room where costumes are being prepared.
observation.dancers: A group of adult men, shirtless with painted faces and leaf skirts, performing the dance together; some women and children appear in the documentary footage.
observation.formation_and_space: Group arranged in staggered rows facing forward in an open field, performing synchronized movements and marching in line outdoors.
observation.posture: Low athletic stance with knees bent wide, torso leaning slightly forward, weight held low in the legs.
observation.footwork: Stamping and stepping dynamically on the beat, low lunges, quick weight shifts, and rapid crouching and springing motions.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms wielding wooden weapons (spears or paddles), thrusting, waving, holding objects aloft, and gesturing forcefully.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso twisting and crouching with powerful, aggressive isolations and expressive upper body contractions.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level deep knee bends and crouched lunges, sharp postural changes, occasional turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Men wear leaf skirts (fala) and leaf shoulder garlands, black face paint, and hold wooden weapons; documentary segments show people making the leaf skirts.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact acoustic properties of instrumental accompaniment due to dominant vocals and chanting; fine details of footwork obscured by grass.

signature_moments.what: Group lunges low with bent knees while thrusting wooden weapons forward in unison.
